result.title: MoWE: Spatially Adaptive Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts Pooling for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
result.summary: We present Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts (MoWE), a spatially adaptive routing mechanism that replaces max-pooling and strided convolutions in U-Net architectures for ultrasound lesion segmentation. Standard pooling operations suppress high-frequency spatial details, including potential boundary cues in speckled regions. Recent frequency-domain methods preserve some of these details, but a single wavelet family applies the same spectral bias across the image. MoWE instead uses a context-aware router to assign local regions to fixed wavelet families according to local texture and global feature context. The decoder reuses the encoder's spatial routing maps during the inverse transform. Learnable channel-wise gates rescale the high-frequency subbands before reconstruction. We evaluate MoWE with U-Net on four ultrasound lesion benchmarks (BUSI, TN3K, UDIAT, BUS-UCLM) and one cardiac dataset (CAMUS), and with nnU-Net on BUSI. On BUSI, MoWE improves U-Net Dice from 72.59\% to 74.55\% and reduces HD95 from 47.01 to 43.49\,px. With nnU-Net, MoWE improves Dice from 80.18\% to 81.97\% and reduces ASSD from 20.07 to 17.25\,px. On U-Net, MoWE reduces trainable parameters by 6.4\%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MoWE，用上下文感知的路由器把局部区域分配给固定的小波族，替换 U-Net 中的最大池化与步幅卷积，并在解码器复用编码器的空间路由图、以可学习通道门控缩放高频子带，在多个超声与心脏分割基准上取得 Dice 与边界距离的改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按局部纹理自适应路由 + 门控高频子带」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节在内部状态里如何被选择性保留与压缩提供可核查的方法线索，但该文本身面向分割而非多模态推理，迁移属推测。
